title: emg2pose: Surface EMG and Hand Pose
description: This dataset is a NEMAR re-host and EMG-BIDS conversion of the public Meta emg2pose benchmark, comprising surface electromyography (sEMG) recordings paired with hand pose labels for wrist-worn EMG-based hand pose estimation. It includes 2 kHz, 16-channel sEMG recordings synchronized with joint-angle labels derived from a 26-camera motion-capture rig, spanning 193 users, 370 hours, and approximately 80 million labeled frames across 29 behavioral stages.
methods_description: Surface EMG was recorded at 2 kHz with 16 channels from the wrist, paired with hand pose labels derived from a 26-camera motion-capture rig using inverse kinematics to produce 20 joint-angle channels. The original HDF5 recordings were converted to EMG-BIDS BDF files using a parallel adaptation of facebookresearch/emg2pose PR #6, with BAD_IK annotations marking samples where inverse-kinematics labels are invalid.
